authorized-by.reason: v0.3 Phase 2 / change #E: the seed template at templates/docs-trustmybot/ ships GOALS.md to every new project on first activation. With Phase 2 dropping GOALS/DISCUSSION/BLUEPRINT, the template must drop them too OR the seeding skill creates files that immediately confuse downstream users. Project root CLAUDE.md must also stop calling these files 'required workflow files'. One task to clean both.

task.title: Drop GOALS.md from templates/docs-trustmybot/; rewrite Workflow Files section in plugin CLAUDE.md
task.description:
Two tightly-coupled cleanups.
**1. `templates/docs-trustmybot/`** — currently contains: - `GOALS.md` - `tasks/`
Phase 2 actions: - DELETE `templates/docs-trustmybot/GOALS.md` via `git rm`. This file is no longer relevant; new projects do not need it. - KEEP `templates/docs-trustmybot/tasks/` (with a `.gitkeep` if empty). - ADD a copy of `docs/trustmybot/SPEC-FORMAT.md` at `templates/docs-trustmybot/SPEC-FORMAT.md` (so downstream projects ship with the contract). This file should be a verbatim copy at template-time; if SPEC-FORMAT.md is updated later, the seed-project-agents skill will not retroactively update existing projects (deliberate — projects own their copy). - ADD `templates/docs-trustmybot/snapshots/.gitkeep` so the snapshot dir exists out-of-the-box.
**2. `CLAUDE.md`** (plugin root, NOT TMB workspace root) — Workflow Files section currently lists:
``` | File | Writers | Purpose | |---|---|---| | `docs/trustmybot/GOALS.md` | Human | Intent, priorities, constraints | | `docs/trustmybot/DISCUSSION.md` | architect, Human | Alignment before BLUEPRINT | | `docs/trustmybot/BLUEPRINT.md` | architect (Human approves) | Phased plan | | `docs/trustmybot/tasks/*.xml` | architect | Per-task execution specs for SWE | ```
Replace with:
``` | Artifact | Storage | Writers | Purpose | |---|---|---|---| | Issue intent + objective | SQLite `issues` table | gatekeeper, architect | Captured via MCP issue_create at routing time | | Architect ↔ Human alignment | SQLite `discussions` table | gatekeeper, architect, human-via-relay | Captured via MCP discussion_append | | Architecture decisions (ADRs) | `docs/trustmybot/architecture/manual/decisions/N-*.md` | architect | Hand-curated; consumer of Phase 5 | | Per-task execution spec | `docs/trustmybot/tasks/.md` | architect | Markdown frontmatter + body — see `docs/trustmybot/SPEC-FORMAT.md` | | Read-only review snapshot | `docs/trustmybot/snapshots/.md` | MCP `issue_snapshot_md` (called by architect / pr-reviewer) | Generated for human review handoff | | Task lifecycle state | SQLite `tasks` + `validation_attempts` | swe (status), pr-reviewer (validation_record), architect (close) | Authoritative. Files are snapshots. | ```
Update **Mode Rules** in the same file (lines ~76-82). The current text references "GOALS.md has unclosed goals". Replace with: "1. MCP issue_resume returns an open issue with pending tasks → Workflow Mode 2. Human explicitly says 'direct mode' / 'just do it' → Direct Mode 3. Multi-file coordinated changes → Workflow Mode 4. Simple read-only question → gatekeeper handles directly, no agent spawn"
Also update **Source Code Access Control** "What the architect CAN edit" to add `docs/trustmybot/snapshots/` (architect generates snapshots via MCP, but the directory should be in the allow-list for any direct write needs).
No other CLAUDE.md sections change.
**3. The TMB workspace root `CLAUDE.md`** at `/Users/Zax/Git/GitHub/TMB/CLAUDE.md` is OUT OF SCOPE for this task — it's a workspace doc, not a plugin doc, and lives in a different repo (TMB workspace, not the plugin git repo). Do NOT touch it.

files.file: `git rm templates/docs-trustmybot/GOALS.md`. Phase 2 removes the file-based goals workflow.
Copy of `docs/trustmybot/SPEC-FORMAT.md` (verbatim contents at task execution time). Implementer SHOULD read the source file and write its current contents — do NOT create a stub or placeholder.
Empty file to keep the directory in git. Skip if already present.
Replace the Workflow Files table per description. Update the Mode Rules section. Add `docs/trustmybot/snapshots/` to the architect allow-list under Source Code Access Control.

task.success-criteria: - `templates/docs-trustmybot/GOALS.md` no longer exists; `git log --diff-filter=D --follow` shows the deletion. - `templates/docs-trustmybot/SPEC-FORMAT.md` exists and contains the same heading and required sections as `docs/trustmybot/SPEC-FORMAT.md`. - `templates/docs-trustmybot/tasks/.gitkeep` exists. - `templates/docs-trustmybot/snapshots/.gitkeep` exists. - `CLAUDE.md` Workflow Files table contains rows for SQLite `issues`, SQLite `discussions`, `tasks/.md`, `snapshots/.md`, and SQLite `tasks` + `validation_attempts`. - `CLAUDE.md` no longer lists GOALS.md, DISCUSSION.md, or BLUEPRINT.md as required workflow files. - `CLAUDE.md` no longer references `tasks/*.xml`. - `CLAUDE.md` Mode Rules cite MCP `issue_resume` instead of GOALS.md. - `CLAUDE.md` Source Code Access Control includes `docs/trustmybot/snapshots/` under "What the architect CAN edit". - `/Users/Zax/Git/GitHub/TMB/CLAUDE.md` (workspace) is unchanged.
task.out-of-scope: - Editing the TMB workspace root CLAUDE.md (different repo). - Updating `seed-project-agents` skill to copy SPEC-FORMAT.md (skill iterates the templates/docs-trustmybot/ tree and copies everything; adding the new file there auto-includes it. Verify by reading the skill — if it has an explicit allowlist of file names, add the file to the allowlist as a follow-up). - Updating bro-template/ if it still exists (Phase 1 should have renamed/removed it; verify and surface as a follow-up if not). - Migrating any existing project's docs/trustmybot/ on `claude --update plugin` (deferred — Phase 6 release notes will document a manual cleanup step).

task.commit:
